purpose: Retrospective development-only test of a causal adaptive threshold controller intended to reduce false-positive rate for the already-frozen Phase II direct-onset engineered forecaster.
claim_boundary: The 2017 score period was already inspected in Phase II V1. This controller replay is therefore post-hoc development evidence only and must not be described as held-out validation, independent confirmation, state of the art, operational readiness, or prospective validation.

requested_operating_goal.primary_goal: reduce retrospective 2017 FPR to <= 0.30 without using future labels at any issue time

controller.rationale: A 15 percentage-point guard band below the requested 30% FPR cap is frozen before controller replay to absorb temporal score-distribution drift. Only prior negative outcomes whose full 24-hour target window has ended, plus a one-hour availability buffer, may update the threshold.

controller_threshold_at_time_t_may_use: negative model scores from prior rows whose 24-hour labels are fully resolved before time t

required: controller FPR <= 0.30 on the retrospective 2017 replay
controller uses no future labels or future scores
success_gate.interpretation_if_passed: engineering proof-of-concept only; must be frozen and tested prospectively or on a genuinely uninspected cohort before performance claims
